text:
Maya R.: quick FYI— two customers got an unhelpful 413 when mixed-dim arrays hit the fastpath splitter. support couldn't recommend next steps.
Jessica L.: we should return structured errors. proposal: 413 with body `{ code: "embed_oversize", reason: "mixed_dims_or_bytes", hint: "call /v1/embeddings/preflight or opt-in X-Embed-AutoSplit" }`.
Arun P.: runtime: we can fallback to slowpath but currently clients that fast-fail get immediate 413. choices: runtime fallback default OR teach SDKs to preflight on that error.
Ryan H.: SDK is fastest. plan: detect 413 + embed_oversize, call POST /v1/embeddings/preflight, apply split plan, retry. add opt-in header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true`. will prototype py/ts and emit `embed_retry_after_split` metric.
Sam K.: console idea: small "Fix 413s" widget on route page when 413s spike — show suggested split, sample curl, and one-click preflight modal.
deploy-bot: canary rollout `embed-splitter:v2` -> us-west-2 (20%).
Jessica L.: spec notes: error.hint_type values: `preflight`, `dimension_hint`, `bytes_hint`. include `expected_dims` when known. document change.
Arun P.: also add header `x-embed-splitter-reason: mixed-dims;preferred_split=1536` for proxies/telemetry. traces already include preferred_split.
Ryan H.: client flow example: send `X-Embed-Client-Hint: dims=4096,batch=20`. on 413 -> call /v1/embeddings/preflight -> use plan -> resend chunks. SDK default off; opt-in header required.
Maya R.: owners/timeline: Ryan — SDK PR & tests this week. Jessica+Arun — spec & docs. Sam — console mock by Friday. I'll open a short support runbook.
Sam K.: Grafana queries: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status="413"}[5m])) by (route)` and `413 / total_requests` with drilldown to `embed.preflight.offered`.
Ryan H.: will emit tag `embed.fastpath.reject_reason` (mixed_dims/bytes/unparsable) and metric `embed.preflight.offered`.
Jessica L.: include preflight example in docs: `{ plan: [ { start:0, end:10, dims:1536 }, { start:10, end:20, dims:512 } ], estimated_tokens:12345 }`.
Maya R.: sync tomorrow 11am to close PRs and wire dashboard. tagging docs/support. thanks! :thumbsup:
